title: Mobile back navigation for non-tabbed pages
goal: Audit finding: Shopping list, Catalog manager, Settings, and Review-queue have no entry in layout.tsx's TABBAR_ITEMS and no backHref set on their MobileTopBar -- reachable only via inbound links, with no in-app way back except the OS back gesture.
in_scope: Set backHref on MobileTopBar for the shopping-list, catalog-manager, settings, and review-queue pages, pointing at the logical parent screen each is actually reached from.
out_of_scope: Adding these pages to the bottom tab bar -- that's an IA decision already made deliberately for the 5-item tab bar (E-16), not reopened here; this story is about a back affordance, not tab-bar placement.
acceptance: Shopping list, Catalog manager, Settings, and Review-queue each show a working back action on mobile that returns to their logical parent screen.
